title: programs-sites.site.changed.v1 payload
description: Full registry state of one Masa site and its pool assignments.

siteId.description: Legacy site id as stored in tsettings.SiteID, for example default, umbrella or tenant-a.

publicUserPoolId.description: Legacy site id of the public user pool; the site's own id when unset.

privateUserPoolId.description: Legacy site id of the private (system) user pool; the site's own id when unset.

categoryPoolId.description: Legacy site id of the category pool; the site's own id when unset.

filePoolId.description: Legacy site id of the file pool; the site's own id when unset.

displayPoolId.description: Legacy site id of the display (theme) pool; the site's own id when unset.

contentPoolIds.description: Legacy site ids of the contentPoolID list in stored order; [siteId] when unset.

domains.description: Site Domain followed by its CRLF-separated domainAlias entries; empty when neither is set.
